## Requirements: E2E execution cost, conditional preparation, and job-scoped runtime reuse

### Problem / verified source state (main, 2026-10-17)

Nession has the canonical `e2e/runner/runtime/full-stack.js` harness (#1474) and trusted Issue-selected E2E planning/per-ID evidence (#1700/#1701/#1702). **Within one selected Playwright process**, multiple IDs already share one Server + Agent + Web + isolated tmux lifecycle. This is **not** a cross-workflow, persistent environment pool.

Remaining avoidable work in the current implementation:

1. `.github/workflows/e2e-tests.yml` determines the Issue selection but still always provisions tmux, installs Playwright/Chromium, builds Web and Rust binaries, and invokes `design-system-browser` before the `not-required` branch skips browser regression. **Do not assume all of these steps can be skipped**: `gates/checks/design-system-browser.sh` currently requires both `web/node_modules` and `e2e/node_modules`; preserve the design gate on its authoritative paths.
2. `gates/checks/e2e-playwright.sh` starts a selected login/session-lifecycle canary and then a separate `--all` suite. Playwright `globalSetup` provisions/tears down the full stack on each invocation, so a full Gate normally provisions it **twice**. Preserve canary/selector assurance, but not a redundant real-stack startup.
3. `.github/workflows/acceptance-cases.yml` selects multiple source-aligned Issue/SC Cases, then loops through `./e2e/run acceptance`. Each `e2e/acceptance/evaluator/run-case.mjs` call creates and destroys a separate full stack, even when Cases run sequentially at the same target SHA/profile.
4. GitHub-hosted `ubuntu-latest` jobs and their running processes are ephemeral. `actions/cache` for Cargo/npm/Chromium is artifact/dependency caching, **not** reuse of a live runtime. A persistent cross-Workflow Environment Pool, VPN runner, remote staging/production verification and reusable deployment proof are **out of scope** here (#1616 owns remote verification).

### Scope and invariants

**Phase A — conditional work and redundant full Gate execution**

- Keep the trusted Issue E2E selection owner, exact PR-head SHA, deterministic New/Regression union, changed-spec coverage, `selected | not-required | full` distinctions, and legacy fallback. Plan before avoidable expensive E2E-only preparation. Skip Rust compilation/full-stack startup and other dependencies only when no remaining mandatory Gate/step needs them. Preserve `design-system-browser` execution and its Node dependencies, or migrate it only through its owning Gate contract with parity proof; no skipped required quality check.
- Remove the second **real** full-stack provisioning in a Full Gate. Retain positive/negative proof of `--id` selection and per-file results using bounded test/contract verification, or one single Playwright process with equivalent mandatory checks; never silently erase the historical selector assurance. A staging/main push remains **full** even if a PR previously ran selected IDs.
- Leave `e2e/run test --id`, `--all`, `--suite`, the full `e2e-playwright` Gate, and Issue E2E ingestion contracts stable. No test output or empty/not-required plan may be claimed as Playwright Pass without proof.

**Phase B — reuse within one Acceptance / Cases job**

- Add a narrow, canonical **job-scoped** runtime acquisition/execution/release contract to the existing `e2e/runner`, not a second harness. Batch eligible sequential Cases for one target SHA + runtime profile/config into one owned stack. Keep independent `<issue>/<SC>` source Case identity, contract digest, Case tree SHA, run-attempt provenance, verifier results and **separate per-SC** outcome records.
- **Isolation first:** explicitly define and verify per-Case state reset (DB, NESSION_HOME artifacts, tmux/session state, clients/fixtures, browser context, ports). Reuse only if reset and health/readiness can be proven without altering intended verifier semantics. For non-resettable or intentionally stateful Cases, transparently fall back to a fresh isolated runtime. Same SHA alone does **not** authorize sharing mutable state.
- One lifecycle owner must guarantee bounded stop/cleanup on failure, timeout, cancellation, and partial start; never kill another task's processes/tmux sockets or erase unowned paths. Preserve existing `run-case` single-Case CLI and local CI-only execution safety.
- Preserve existing trusted `acceptance-results` immutable records / ingestion, stage-specific methods and Issue projection. No new Case can inherit another Case's Pass; a failed Case cannot suppress independent evidence from others.

**Measurements:** Publish bounded, non-sensitive before/after CI evidence (selected mode, target SHA, relevant Gate outcome, full-stack startup count, build/provision/test durations, executed Case/ID count, isolation fallback count). Compare equivalent execution scopes; do not promise arbitrary percentage reductions.

### Out of scope / dependencies

- No cross-PR, cross-Workflow or cross-run live environment reuse; no persistent Environment Registry, lease manager, shared mutable database, Kubernetes pool or self-hosted VPN runner in this issue. Reassess a **separate** environment-pool requirement after Phase A/B timings demonstrate value.
- No code→test capability graph, no new Issue E2E selector/projector, no downgrade from Full E2E to Selected E2E, no shortcut around exact-SHA evidence, no production/deployed verification.
- Integrate existing #1474 Runner, #1702 Issue selection, #1649 Acceptance workflow, #1690 Run Store integrity; #1616 remains the owner of remote VPN/deployed E2E profiles.
- Changes under `.github/workflows/*` must follow `.github/AGENTS.md`: isolated **main-based** worktree/PR, merged **to main with merge commit**, independent from unrelated staging feature changes.

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 On a real PR with valid explicit `none` and no modified specs, the trusted `not-required` plan skips E2E-only Rust build/full-stack startup while the required design/quality Gates still execute; malformed/no-authorization plans retain conservative behavior and never get a fabricated Pass.
- [x] SC-02 On a real multi-ID selected PR, only obligated/newly changed IDs run in **one** Playwright process and **one** runtime with no missing per-ID assertion evidence; main/staging push still performs the canonical full regression.
- [x] SC-03 A Full E2E Gate provisions the full stack at most **once** per Gate invocation, yet its legacy full-coverage and selector/canary assurance are independently demonstrated; fail/skipped/zero-assertion and unknown-ID cases remain non-Pass.
- [x] SC-04 Two or more eligible Acceptance Cases at the same exact SHA/profile execute sequentially with one proven-ready job-owned runtime while each retains an independent, correctly attributed Issue/SC verdict and immutable provenance.
- [ ] SC-05 A Case that mutates shared state is reset and demonstrably isolated before reuse, or triggers an explicit **fresh runtime fallback**. A dirty DB/tmux/session, incompatible profile/SHA or failed health check can never cause false Pass or cross-Case contamination.
- [ ] SC-06 Runner and workflow failure, partial start, timeout, cancellation and retries perform bounded **owned-resource** cleanup, preserve independent successful/failed evidence and do not affect foreign tmux/processes/paths.
- [ ] SC-07 Source Workflow, exact SHA/attempt, selection plan and Case result contracts remain accepted by existing trusted main-owned ingestion/projectors and `acceptance-results` consumers; no prior stale/foreign evidence becomes reusable or upgradeable to Pass.
- [ ] SC-08 Real CI evidence compares equivalent pre/post paths for startup count, setup/build/test time, executed IDs/Cases and reuse/fallback decisions; canonical Gate/self-test coverage and main-push full E2E remain passing without weakening required checks.

## E2E Verification

### New
- none: CI/runtime orchestration and lifecycle optimization do not introduce a new browser-visible scenario; verify orchestration, reuse, reset and negative cases through dedicated source-aligned Acceptance Cases and deterministic Gates.

### Regression
- login
- session-lifecycle
- terminal-io
